h1: Custom 14 oz Locks for Branded Security
metaDescription: Order custom 14 oz locks for bulk branding. Durable padlocks with logo imprinting at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Custom 14 oz locks offer a solid, weighty feel that signals quality and durability. This heavier weight is ideal for securing gym lockers, storage units, or industrial cabinets where a substantial lock inspires confidence. Choose from brass or laminated steel bodies, and add your logo via pad printing or laser engraving for a professional look that stands up to daily use.
heroAltText: Custom 14 oz locks with engraved logo on heavy-duty padlock for bulk orders
